risks.note: Margins are sensitive to prices of steel, aluminium, brass and other non-ferrous metals and electronic components, which were elevated during FY26 and compressed EBITDA margins; the Company was not always able to pass on the full impact to customers given competitive OEM pricing dynamics.
risks.risk: Raw material and input cost risk

risks.note: A meaningful share of revenue continues to be derived from a limited set of large automotive OEMs, exposing the Company to their production cycles, sourcing decisions and price negotiations.

Newly signed technology-licensing and assistance agreements require successful localisation, testing and OEM validation before they translate into revenue; delays could affect the pace of growth in the Electronics/EV components segment.

Changes in emission norms, delays or modifications to EV/CNG incentive schemes including PM E-DRIVE, or deferment of anticipated AIS-135 fire-safety mandates could affect demand for the Company's product lines.
Working capital days increased to 98 in FY26 (FY25: 84), with debtor and inventory cycles remaining elevated relative to historical levels, increasing reliance on borrowings.
The proposed deferment of TREM-V norms for the specified tractor segment to 2032 may delay the adoption of CBG-powered tractors and defer the Company's planned expansion into the tractor segment.
Rising borrowings to fund capacity expansion increase exposure to interest rate movements; finance cost rose during FY26 versus FY25.

The automotive component industry remains sensitive to macroeconomic cycles, fuel-price differentials, and geopolitical developments such as the ongoing West Asia conflict, which could affect input costs, freight rates and OEM production schedules.

Ltd. for EV controllers and auxiliary inverters

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Margins are sensitive to prices of steel, aluminium, brass and other non-ferrous metals and electronic components, which were elevated during FY26 and compressed EBITDA margins; the Company was not always able to pass on the full impact to customers given competitive OEM pricing dynamics.
- A meaningful share of revenue continues to be derived from a limited set of large automotive OEMs, exposing the Company to their production cycles, sourcing decisions and price negotiations.
- Newly signed technology-licensing and assistance agreements require successful localisation, testing and OEM validation before they translate into revenue; delays could affect the pace of growth in the Electronics/EV components segment.
- Changes in emission norms, delays or modifications to EV/CNG incentive schemes including PM E-DRIVE, or deferment of anticipated AIS-135 fire-safety mandates could affect demand for the Company's product lines.
- Working capital days increased to 98 in FY26 (FY25: 84), with debtor and inventory cycles remaining elevated relative to historical levels, increasing reliance on borrowings.
- The proposed deferment of TREM-V norms for the specified tractor segment to 2032 may delay the adoption of CBG-powered tractors and defer the Company's planned expansion into the tractor segment.
- Rising borrowings to fund capacity expansion increase exposure to interest rate movements; finance cost rose during FY26 versus FY25.
- The automotive component industry remains sensitive to macroeconomic cycles, fuel-price differentials, and geopolitical developments such as the ongoing West Asia conflict, which could affect input costs, freight rates and OEM production schedules.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Scale the EV components and Electronics business for localisation of auxiliary controllers for electric buses, with progressive ramp-up of the Jhajjar facility for EMS and EV-component manufacturing.
- Commercialise the technology partnership with V&T Electric (Xinjiang) Co. Ltd. to localise controllers, EV controllers and auxiliary inverters, with a stated ambition of achieving 75% localisation within three years under Government EV incentive schemes including PM E-DRIVE.
- Deepen the Fire Protection Systems franchise by expanding into State Transport Undertakings and private fleet operators …
